subject: SpectralBank - reserved commit delta causing latency & 5xx surge
messages:
From: Anja Muller <anja.muller@spectralbank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Production latency spike / 500s in inference pipeline

Hi Karthik / Naomi,

We're seeing a sudden, sustained latency increase and a wave of 5xx errors hitting our inference routes since ~09:00 UTC. Impact summary:~
- P95 latency up from ~140ms to ~3.2s
- 5xx rate ~18% over the last 45 minutes (affecting both generation and chat endpoints)
- Observed token queue growth and throat-holing on our reserved pool (reserved commit shows 75% usage but effective throughput is throttled)

Attached: spectrum_logs_20260918.zip (logs + lightweight trace). We've scoped this to our dedicated GPU pool: it looks like the pool is saturated and requests are queuing even though the committed reservation should cover our baseline.

Can Redwood open a priority lane or authorize burst capacity? This is degrading user flows for our payments product. We need an ETA and a short remediation plan.

Thanks,
Anja
Anja Muller
Head of Platform Reliability
SpectralBank
https://spectralbank.com

Attachment: spectrum_logs_20260918.zip (log bundle, 42MB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike / 500s in inference pipeline

Thanks for the heads-up, Anja (cc'd Naomi/ops). I'm escalating now. Quick read: traces show sustained KV-cache backlog + a noisy tenant doing long-history generations that ballooned effective sequence lengths. That combination can starve the reserved pool despite committed slots.

Immediate asks:
1) Irene/infra: can you open a temporary burst authorization for SpectralBank's pool (2x for 90 minutes) and enable cross-region spill to us-east-2? Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-9012
2) Naomi: please coordinate a customer note confirming we're initiating burst and mitigation (ETA target 30m)
3) Marissa: loop in SRE for priority throttling knobs + identify noisy tenant (if multi-tenant spillover)

Irene — I've attached a screenshot from the capacity dashboard (capacity-dashboard.png) showing token queue depth. If burst is not possible, fallback plan: downgrade a fraction of SpectralBank traffic to the smaller quantized variant (q4) to reduce per-token compute. That requires a quick model-mapping change but should reduce headroom pressure.

I'll join a bridge if we need an exec sync.

-Karthik
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: capacity-dashboard.png

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:28:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike / 500s in inference pipeline

On Fri, Sep 18, 2026 at 4:20 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Irene/infra: can you open a temporary burst authorization for SpectralBank's pool (2x for 90 minutes) and enable cross-region spill to us-east-2?

We're standing this up now. Quick status:
- Burst request queued with provisioning; infra estimates 18-24 minutes to attach additional nodes (we're prioritizing SpectralBank due to production impact)
- Cross-region spill to us-east-2 enabled for their model routes; routing change propagated to edge in ~6m
- SRE is rate-limiting an identified noisy tenant (session-id: a1b2c3) to the lower-priority tier; this should free ~22% of pool headroom

Temporary mitigations applied:
- Fallback mapping applied for 20% of SpectralBank traffic to q4-small (logs in spectral_qa_snippet.txt)
- Rolling restart of one inference cluster completed to flush KV-cache fragmentation

I'll update when burst nodes attach. If provisioning slips past 30m we should consider a customer credit/burst compensation as a remedial step.

-Irene
Principal Infra Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: spectral_qa_snippet.txt

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike / 500s in inference pipeline

Thanks team — good triage. Approving immediate burst (2x for 90m) and cross-region spill. Naomi, please send a brief note to Anja explaining actions taken and an estimated timeline (aim for <30 minutes). Also: put the exec readout on my calendar for 09/19 09:00 ET to review root cause and remediation timeline; I want SRE + PM on the call.

We should be conservative on credits; only commit if provisioning slips beyond 60 minutes or client SLA thresholds are breached. Keep legal/sales looped for any post-incident commercial asks.

-Vivek
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Anja Muller <anja.muller@spectralbank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike / 500s in inference pipeline

Karthik / Naomi — thank you. We see latency returning toward baseline after the cross-region spill and SRE throttles. We'll hang on for the exec readout tomorrow and share our internal postmortem once we complete traces (we also uploaded a small trace dump to your bucket).

Please confirm final remediation steps after the 09/19 sync so we can map contract remedies if needed. Appreciate the quick attention.

Best,
Anja
Head of Platform Reliability
SpectralBank
